description: DIXI Spec Kit: local SDD core in development.
lang: Language for messages and new documents.
init: Create a documentary baseline in a new or empty destination.
doctor: Diagnose local requirements without network or credentials.
check: Check structure and traceability without executing code.
directory: Destination directory; its parent must exist.
agent: Distributed integration: none (no agent), claude (Claude Code commands), codex (Codex skills) or skills (Agent Skills for other compatible agents).
profile_option: Content profile: minimal (default, current baseline), site, app or platform.
regulated_option: Add compliance, due diligence and stricter security templates (requires site, app or platform).
regulated_requires_profile: --regulated needs a profile: site, app or platform.
initialized_existing: DIXI added to {path}: {created} files created, {adopted} already identical, {conflicts} kept as they were (listed below; review them by hand).
already_initialized: {path} is already a DIXI project; use `dixi upgrade --dry-run` instead.
structure_only: Scope: documentary structure. This does not certify application tests or readiness to build.
unsafe_path: Unsafe path, symbolic link, or access outside the permitted scope.
unsafe_destination: Unsafe destination: use a new or empty directory, without '..' or symbolic links. Inside an empty folder, run `dixi init .`.
unsupported_platform: Platform lacks required safe filesystem operations; no unsafe fallback was used.
invalid_file: Invalid or nonregular file, or a read/analysis limit exceeded: {path}
destination_conflict: Destination is occupied or changed during the operation; files are not overwritten. To add DIXI to a folder that already has files, use `dixi init <folder> --existing`.
missing_project: Project metadata is missing. Run check from an initialized project root.
invalid_metadata: Invalid project metadata or incomplete inventory.
unsupported_schema: Schema or kit version is not supported by this installation.
invalid_trace: Invalid traceability graph: check types, unique IDs, and paths.
invalid_link: Invalid or unsafe local link in: {path}
resources_ok: Local resources available; safe filesystem operations available.
agent_none: Integration: none. No agent required. Project language: {language}
agent_claude: Integration: Claude Code. Installed commands: {commands} of {available}. Project language: {language}
agent_codex: Integration: Codex. Installed skills: {skills} of {available}. Project language: {language}
agent_skills: Integration: Agent Skills in .agents/skills/ (Cursor, VS Code/Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and other compatible agents). Installed skills: {skills} of {available}. Project language: {language}
no_project_optional: No project in this directory; general diagnosis completed.
invalid_arguments: Invalid arguments. See dixi --help; global options precede the command.
io_error: Input/output failure. Initialization may be partial; inspect the destination before retrying.
workflow: Consult procedures and prepare context without running an agent.
workflow_show: Show a procedure's inputs, steps, outputs and gates.
workflow_prepare: Prepare instructions and a target manifest; no writes or AI execution.
workflow_target: Exact ID of a compatible target in the graph.
workflow_request: Explicit request; up to 4,096 characters, without secrets.
workflow_scope: Scope: consultation or preparation. Does not execute the procedure, generate specs or certify approval or tests.
invalid_workflow_request: Request is empty, too long or contains unsupported characters.
invalid_workflow_target: Target ID is unknown or incompatible with this procedure.
workflow_context_limit: Context exceeds 64 sources or 2 MiB combined.
invalid_workflow_mode: MODE must contain mvp or prod.
workflow_no_next: Continue with human review and task planning; execution is not included yet.
upgrade: Preview (--dry-run) or apply (--apply) what this kit version changes in the project.
upgrade_dry_run: Compute the plan only; no file is written.
upgrade_apply: Write only updatable and new kit files; never your edits, deleted or obsolete files.
upgrade_requires_mode: Choose exactly one: `dixi upgrade --dry-run` to preview or `dixi upgrade --apply` to apply.
upgrade_applied: Upgrade from kit {source} to {target}: {applied} files applied; {left} left for you to review.
upgrade_locked: Another upgrade is running or was interrupted: check the project, then remove `.dixi-upgrade.lock`.
upgrade_hint: Newer commands are available; run `dixi upgrade --dry-run` to review them.
project_newer: The project was created with kit {version}, newer than this installation. Update dixi first.
controls_option: Install opt-in agent hooks that enforce frozen tests, no secrets, no signing or merging, production-mode safety and verification before stopping (requires --agent claude or codex).
existing_option: Add DIXI to a folder that already has files: create only what is missing and never overwrite.
placeholders: List the {{pending: …}} markers left in the project's documents.
pr-size: Measure the current branch against a base: changed lines, without documentation, lockfiles, generated files or tests.
controls_require_agent: --controls needs an agent: --agent claude or --agent codex.
pr_size_result: Change against {base}: {counted} counted lines (limit {max}); tests {tests}; excluded {excluded}.
pr_size_exceeded: The change has {counted} counted lines, over the limit of {max}: split it so a person can review it.
pr_size_git: Could not measure the change: Git is missing, this is not a repository or the base {base} does not exist.
extension: Add, list or remove local data-only extensions that add operations (ADR-109).
extension_add: Install an extension folder (extension.json and operations/en|es/*.md) for the project's agent.
extension_remove: Remove an extension: deletes only the files it installed that you have not edited.
extension_folder: Folder of the extension on the local disk.
extension_removed: Extension {id} removed: {removed} files deleted, {kept} kept because you edited them.
extension_conflict: Extension conflict, nothing was written: {path} already exists.
extensions_require_agent: Extensions need an agent: create the project with --agent claude, codex or skills.
preset: Add, list or remove local data-only presets that override kit texts (ADR-109).
preset_add: Apply a preset folder (preset.json, operations/en|es, templates/en|es) to unedited kit files.
preset_remove: Remove a preset: restores the kit text only where the preset text is unchanged.
preset_folder: Folder of the preset on the local disk.
preset_added: Preset {id} {version} applied to {applied} files; {kept} kept (your edits, your overrides or a higher-priority preset).
preset_removed: Preset {id} removed: {restored} files back to the kit text, {kept} kept because they changed.
preset_conflict: Preset conflict, nothing was written: {path} already exists.
mode: Show MODE and, for mvp, the promotion items without evidence. Read-only: it never changes MODE.
mode_prod: MODE is prod: there is no promotion to prepare.
mode_invalid: MODE must be mvp or prod; found: {value}
mode_item_tests: No evidence for tests and budgets: {expected}
mode_item_threats: No evidence for the threat model: {expected}
mode_item_operations: No evidence for runbooks and SLOs: {expected}
mode_item_release: No evidence for the release and rollback process: {expected}
mode_summary: {missing} of {total} promotion items have no evidence (a document without pending blanks). /dixi.promote prepares the checklist; only a person changes MODE.
mode_complete: Every promotion item has evidence. /dixi.promote prepares the checklist; only a person changes MODE.
